claims.text: INDIA bloc leaders and supporters marched towards Jantar Mantar demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
Delhi Police guidelines specify that protest gatherings at Jantar Mantar cannot exceed 1,000 people and prior permission must be requested 10 days in advance.
Opposition parties accused Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar of deleting lakhs of names from electoral rolls through the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise.
Cockroach Janta Party co-convenor Saurav Das submitted an intimation letter at Parliament Street police station for an October 10 protest at Jantar Mantar.
Delhi Police detained Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke and All India Students' Association president Neha Bora ahead of the 'Lehra Do Tiranga' protest.
Delhi Police stated that approximately 150 people were detained in central Delhi as part of efforts to maintain law and order.
Delhi Police imposed prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) in Connaught Place and closed Central Park on October 16 and 17.
Advocate Supantha Sinha stated that Neha Bora was taken into custody around 5:00 pm, and her location at RK Puram police station was disclosed around 10:30 pm.
Police sources stated that Abhijeet Dipke was detained at Jhandewalan while travelling towards Connaught Place.
Cockroach Janta Party leader Rohan Deshpande wrote to the Mandir Marg station house officer seeking details on Abhijeet Dipke's location and legal grounds for his detention.
CPI(M) Rajya Sabha MP John Brittas stated that Neha Bora was picked up by Delhi Police at Mandi House while on her way to join the protest.
A 19-year-old man was arrested in Palatine near Chicago for allegedly planning a mass shooting at the Sri Venkateswara Temple in Aurora, Illinois.
Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal called on US authorities to ensure the safety, security, and well-being of Indian nationals.
US Representative Raja Krishnamoorthi stated that he and his family were present at the Sri Venkateswara Temple when the attempted attack occurred.
Investigators recovered a manifesto attributed to suspect Alexandro Paporakis expressing white-supremacist hatred toward Indian, Jewish, and Black people.
More than 50 American lawmakers and public officials condemned the attempted mass shooting at the Hindu temple in Illinois.
Alexandros Paporakis was arrested on October 11, 2026, and charged with making a terrorist threat and illegal possession of weapons.
Law enforcement recovered a rifle, loaded magazines, hundreds of rounds of ammunition, and a tactical vest with body armour from Alexandros Paporakis' residence.
Palatine Police Chief William Nord stated that a colleague alerted authorities after receiving concerning electronic messages from Alexandros Paporakis.
Authorities reported that Alexandros Paporakis drove to the Aurora temple on Sunday, but his rifle jammed when he attempted to open fire.
According to a study by the Center for the Study of Organized Hate, online hate against South Asians in the US surged 240% between January 2024 and June 2026.
Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated that External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar will host US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Mumbai on October 20, 2026.
Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated that S. Jaishankar will host UAE Deputy Prime Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan in Mumbai on October 19, 2026.
External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar will attend the US 250th anniversary independence celebrations in Mumbai as the guest of honour.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel to India to further strengthen bilateral energy cooperation.
Congress leader Rahul Gandhi criticized the government regarding Marco Rubio's visit, stating on X, 'Mr Rubio has summoned his employee to Mumbai.'
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is scheduled to visit Mumbai and Jamnagar during his trip to India.
Marco Rubio will visit Reliance facilities in Jamnagar, which partnered on constructing the America First Refining facility in Texas.
US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor announced at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum that Washington expected S. Jaishankar to meet Marco Rubio in Mumbai.
Congress leader Jairam Ramesh questioned why the announcement of S. Jaishankar's meetings was made by the US ambassador rather than the Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson.
In August 2025, the US imposed an additional 25% tariff on Indian imports due to India's purchases of Russian crude oil, which was removed in February 2026 following an interim trade deal.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is expected to arrive in Mumbai on October 18, 2026, marking his second visit to India in 2026.
